Coca-Cola's gross margin in fiscal Q4 2023 was about 57.3%.

The Q4 2023 earnings release (SEC filing) reports these figures for the three months ended December 31, 2023:

- **Cost of goods sold:** $4,634 million.
- **Gross profit:** $6,215 million.
- **Net operating revenues:** about $10,850 million. I added cost of goods sold and gross profit to get $10,849 million, so this is a rounding-level estimate.

Gross margin is gross profit divided by net operating revenues: 6,215 / 10,850 ≈ 57.3%.
